verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own docs say users can open the Model behind any answer and 'check every number' (cfo-ai-docs-32). They also say outputs 'print[] lineage back to the source line' and that the Model is built from formulas, which survive Excel export (cfo-ai-docs-34, cfo-ai-docs-21, cfo-ai-docs-8). Together these cover tracing a reported number through formulas to source rows. Missing for 10: a detailed first-party description of the drill-down/trace UI (the lineage claim is a single marketing line whose subject, 'each one', is ambiguous), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that tracing works for every report figure.
